sharedPermitNote: About 110 acres of mapped wetlands (freshwater forested/shrub wetland, freshwater pond, riverine) lie in the 652-acre corridor the two projects would share. Work that touches wetlands needs a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers permit under Clean Water Act Section 404, usually Nationwide Permit 57 for utility lines, backed by a wetland delineation and environmental surveys. Doing one delineation and one set of surveys for both utilities, and coordinating their notices to the Corps, avoids paying for the same fieldwork twice. For scale, MISO's cost guide puts wetland matting at $69,975/acre and mitigation credits at $56,132/acre (MTEP24 Table 2.2-9) wherever a project must work in wetlands. NWI maps are a screening tool, not a jurisdictional delineation.
